# Hano Studios

> Hano Studios (legal name Hano Animations) is a Web3 creative agency
> specialising in motion design, ad campaigns and social media management for
> crypto, trading and fintech brands. We are unusual in that we built and still
> run our own crypto media brand, so the growth system we sell is one we proved
> on ourselves first.

## What we do

- **Web3 motion design** — short-form vertical video, paid ad creative, product
  and protocol explainers, brand films, data visualisation, UI animation.
- **Crypto and Web3 social media management** — content strategy, topic
  research, scripting, production and publishing across Instagram, TikTok, X,
  YouTube and LinkedIn. Usually a monthly retainer as the embedded content team.
- **Web3 ad campaigns** — concepting, production, localisation and format
  adaptation so one idea runs natively on every placement.
- **Explainer and launch videos** — product and protocol explainers, launch
  films, app and UI walkthroughs, 3D product animation, data visualisation.
- **Web3 graphic design and brand identity** — visual identity, brand systems,
  campaign design, social and thumbnail systems, presentation design.
- **Web3 website design and development** — we design *and* build: brand and
  product sites, campaign landing pages, motion-led experiences. We do not write
  or audit smart contracts and will refer that work out.
- Also: launch leading, full marketing.

## Verified results

- **Hano Crypto** (our own brand, Instagram @hanocrypto): built from zero to
  **148,000 followers** and **30M+ views** across **200+ videos**, 100% organic —
  no paid ads, no giveaways, no influencer partnerships. Most viral video:
  **8,000,000 views**, ~53s average watch time, **50,000+ new followers** from
  that single post.
- **Bybit** (world's #2 crypto exchange by volume, 80M+ users): produced two
  campaigns for Bybit EU — the visual campaign for their **Bybit Stockholm Open**
  ATP tennis title sponsorship (2026–2028), and the Europe-wide **Bybit Card**
  campaign (3M+ cardholders), in English and Swedish across four formats.
- **Kalshi** (CFTC-regulated prediction market, ~$22B valuation): official
  partner for crypto video content, produced and distributed through the Hano
  Crypto audience. 8 videos, 200k+ views.
- **Levels Socials** (copy trading platform, 15,000 traders): Hano Studios holds
  the CMO role — social media, affiliate marketing, funnel automation and new
  market entries in **four languages** (English, Portuguese, Spanish, German).
  **Two product interfaces** reworked: trading platform and client portal.
- **Maxy** (Bitcoin cross-chain protocol): creative partner for almost a year.
  Website animations that visualise cryptographic verification, serving website,
  docs and investor briefs — a partnership that now spans the entire brand.

Other clients include Algorand, Abstract, Pudgy Penguins,
Humanity Protocol, Virtune and onara.

## Why we are different

Generalist agencies learn crypto on the client's budget. Crypto-native marketers
often cannot produce work anyone wants to watch. The combination — real market
expertise plus production craft — is the whole proposition, and the Hano Crypto
numbers are the evidence that it works rather than a claim about it.
